en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4818 - Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad Al-Jawhari narrated from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah who said:

Abu Ibrahim (Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as)) was asked about a woman whose husband lost his sanity after marrying her or developed insanity.
Imam (as) said: "She has the right to separate herself from him if she wishes."
